name: The Lighthouse Keeper world
premise: After a global electromagnetic event extinguished all digital memory, a lone lighthouse keeper on a remote island maintains the last analog archive. Ships that find their way back bring fragments of the old world.
rules: No functioning digital technology survives; all records are paper or oral.
The lighthouse beam is the only navigational aid for hundreds of kilometers of coast.
Island population: 1 (the keeper), until a stranger arrives in chapter 1.
